# Liquid flow warp

Swirls the image through a slowly changing flow field (curl noise), so it moves like ink in water without tearing.

<EffectDemo effect="flow-warp" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { flowWarp } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/flow-warp';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(flowWarp({ preset: 'ink' }));
// Animated effects hold still until play() (or { autoplay: true }).
composer.play();
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.strength = 4`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter  | Type   | Default | Range     | Description                                          |
| ---------- | ------ | ------- | --------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `strength` | number | `4`     | 0 – 20    | How far the flow carries the image.                  |
| `scale`    | number | `2`     | 0.25 – 10 | Size of the swirls: higher values make smaller ones. |
| `speed`    | number | `0.5`   | 0 – 3     | How fast the flow changes.                           |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset        | Settings                                  |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `ink`         | `strength: 6`, `scale: 1.5`, `speed: 0.3` |
| `psychedelic` | `strength: 14`, `scale: 3`, `speed: 1`    |
| `gentle`      | `strength: 2`, `scale: 1`                 |
| `marble`      | `strength: 10`, `scale: 4`, `speed: 0`    |

Apply one with `flowWarp({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Distortion & warp · tracked as story X9.9 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Freezes: when motion is off (reduced motion, high contrast or `composer.motion = false`) the effect holds its current frame.
- **Size:** 6.9 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/flow-warp`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Bridson, Hourihan and Nordenstam, Curl-noise for procedural fluid flow, 2007.

## Related

- [Heat haze](./heat-haze) — The shimmer of hot air: the image wobbles in small, rising ripples, strongest near the bottom.
- [Wave warp](./wave-warp) — Bends the image along travelling sine waves, horizontally, vertically or both, like a flag in the wind or a reflection in water.
- [Twirl](./twirl) — Twists the image around a point like a whirlpool: strongest at the center and fading out by the edge of the radius.
